Snippet 1 mentions 'more than 60 million Nigerians hold bank accounts' out of over 200 million citizens, which is approximately 30%. The original 2019 CBN goal of 95% by 2024 was clearly not met. Recent evidence shows ongoing financial inclusion efforts but no indication that 95% penetration was achieved.
